classifier.method: exact set-membership + connectivity on the admissible subgraph
classifier.admissibleRule: degree>=2; degree>=3 inside portal convergence (BFS<=3 from portal); shares a biconnected block with the Explorer. Start exempt; portal exempt from the >=3 and block rules.
classifier.equivalence: A satisfying route exists iff start, every light and the portal share one connected component of the admissible subgraph — a walk may revisit cells, so connectivity is necessary and sufficient. Every B witness is confirmed by calling the production routeCellsHaveEscape on the witness route.
